name: Viridian
author: Stormy979
description: Go above the cube portal as the wave at 30%. Navigate through the following gameplay as the wave until 33% where you can fall to the floor between the hitboxes (aim to fall very close to the corner of the structure next to the red orb). At 51%, start navigating through the gameplay as the wave and go under the robot portal at 60% and then go under the ball portal at 67% and then fall back to the floor at 69% (aim to fall a bit before the yellow orb). Move up into the levels gameplay at 72% and go above the 4x speed portal at 74%, hold to the ceiling above the cube portal at 76% until 77% where you can move back into the levels gameplay, go above the cube portal at 79% between the slope, go under the UFO portal at 80%, go under the ship portal at 82%, go above the wave portal at 83%, go above the cube portal at 86% and then enter the ship portal at 88%. Play the rest of the level normally from there.
